brief:
King's College London has reinstated a student who was suspended over pro-Palestine activism, according to Al Jazeera English. The college lifted the suspension following weeks of criticism from student groups who argued the disciplinary action represented a broader institutional crackdown on pro-Palestine sentiment and political expression on campus.

Student organizations had mounted coordinated opposition to the penalty, contending it violated fundamental principles of free speech and academic freedom. Campus groups asserted that the suspension set a troubling precedent for how the university handles politically contentious student conduct. The college's decision to reverse the disciplinary measure reflects mounting pressure from within the university community regarding its approach to student activism and political expression.
dek: College lifts suspension amid criticism from student groups over crackdown on pro-Palestine sentiments.
title: King's College London lifts suspension of pro-Palestine student
